lunch.notes_base: Rating 4.6 stars. An independent international restaurant in the Macau Center mall right in the Wangfujing area. Popular with expats and foreign visitors due to its English menu and relaxed international atmosphere. Much less crowded than the mainstream chain restaurants in nearby malls. Open 10:00-21:30 daily. Perfect for a niche, foreigner-friendly lunch break between shopping sessions.
lunch.notes_local: 评分4.6星，人均约131元。位于王府井澳门中心商场一楼，非连锁独立西餐厅，外国人和外籍人士常来，提供英文菜单，氛围轻松国际化。相比附近各大商场主流连锁餐厅，人流较少不用排队。每日10:00-21:30营业，购物间隙午餐的绝佳选择。

dinner.notes_base: Rating 4.7 stars, ~93 CNY/person. The popular 很久以前 (Hen Jiu Yi Qian) chain known for high-quality lamb skewers and fun lively BBQ atmosphere - exactly the style requested. Located conveniently on 6F of APM mall in Wangfujing. Lively and satisfying eating experience, not formal at all. Open 11:00-14:00 and 16:30-24:00 on weekdays, 11:00-24:00 on weekends. Budget-friendly under 100 CNY per person.
dinner.notes_local: 评分4.7星，人均约93元。知名连锁烤串品牌，以优质羊肉串和热闹欢乐的烧烤氛围著称，风格爽快过瘾。位于王府井APM商场6楼，交通便利。氛围活跃不拘谨，非常适合爽吃一顿。工作日11:00-14:00、16:30-24:00营业，周末11:00-24:00。人均不超过100元，性价比高。
